subject.en: Generative 3D helps game teams skip modeling from scratch
subject.zh: 用生成式 3D，您的游戏团队不用每个道具都从零建模

intro.en:
Hi %FIRSTNAME%,

We’re Tripo AI. We help your team go from concept to production-ready 3D assets, inside your existing workflow.

Each game update has a long list of props, and with generative 3D your team can get more of them in. Artists can start each prop from a generated model instead of building the first shape by hand, and spend that time on game-specific details.

With Tripo AI Studio Team Plan, artists generate first-pass models from text or images in one shared workspace, then continue in Blender, Unity or Unreal.
• **Tripo AI handles the first pass:** Artists get a starting model for each prop on the list.
• **Your team keeps creative control:** Artists refine shape and materials, review the result and decide what ships.

**To help you evaluate the ROI,** we'd be happy to help plan a pilot with 10 live props. Compare time to first useful model, cleanup, review and total cost with your current process.

Contact us today to set up your team's 10-asset pilot.

intro.en:
Hi %FIRSTNAME%,

We’re Tripo AI. We help your team go from concept to production-ready 3D assets, inside your existing workflow.

Once your deliveries include work generated with generative 3D, your team's approved files need to point back to the request and edits behind them. Otherwise the next reviewer has to ask each artist to reconstruct the history.

Your developers can use Tripo AI API task information to connect generation with revision and approval records in your own production tool.
• **We handle generation:** Tripo AI generates the model and provides its task ID, status and output links.
• **You keep control:** Your system saves the requests and inputs, while your team records how artists refine, review and approve each version.

**To help you evaluate that handover, let's plan a 10-asset API test.** Compare time, cost and quality with your current workflow, and check that every final file leads back to its request and approval.

Contact us today to set up your 10-asset API test.
intro.zh:

我们是 Tripo AI。我们帮助您的团队在现有工作流程中，将概念转化为可用于生产的 3D 资产。

工程团队可以利用 Tripo AI API 的任务信息，把生成环节与您自有制作工具里的修改和批准记录连起来。

• **您保留决定权：** 请求和输入存在您的系统里，团队记录美术如何精修、审核和批准每个版本。

**为了帮您评估这个交接环节，可以先安排 10 个资产的 API 测试。** 与现有流程对比时间、成本和质量，并确认每个最终文件都能追回到对应的请求和批准。

立即联系我们，安排您的 10 个资产 API 测试。

followup.en:
Once an artist has refined a model, the final file needs to stay connected to the request and the review that approved it.

A 10-asset test can follow those connections inside your own tool. Your developers save the original request and inputs, collect the API task ID and results, then link working versions, review notes and approvals. Tripo AI supplies generation task information; your system builds and keeps the wider record.

For each asset, record time to its first approved output. Compare history-retrieval time, asset quality and total cost: integration, record maintenance, generation, retries, unsuccessful attempts, refinement, review and file checks in the intended production tool or viewer. Your team sets input permissions, retention, disclosure and final-use requirements.

Before testing, both teams would confirm available information, who checks each record, evaluation support, scope, access and fees. Your team approves the asset; API task data is neither a complete audit trail nor proof of rights or compliance.

Contact us today to set up your 10-asset API test.
